_comment: The provisioning MCP: the MongoDB MCP Server with an Atlas service account. With MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_ID/SECRET the server exposes atlas-* tools (list orgs/projects/clusters, create project, create free cluster, create db user, add access list, connect) next to the data tools. An agent holding this can do everything sandbox.sh does, one tool call at a time. docs/14-sandbox-provisioning.md §3.
